confidence_explanation: The analysis is based on a clear pattern of anomalous behavior: login from an unauthorized IP followed by a sustained, high-volume pattern of reading and downloading files across multiple days, which significantly exceeds the user's baseline for both file access and downloads.

attack_chain.description: Unauthorized login by user_06 from an unusual IP address (139.59.13.50) instead of the normal 192.168.1.106.
Commencement of data collection via file downloads in the shared runbooks directory.
Expansion of data collection to include the user's own department directory (/data/devops/) with large file downloads.
Continued high-volume downloading of files across both shared and departmental directories.
Persistence of the activity on a second day using the same unauthorized IP address.
Systematic pattern of reading and downloading files, indicating premeditated data exfiltration.

gaps: Lack of information regarding whether the IP 139.59.13.50 is a known VPN or remote access gateway used by the company.
No information on whether user_06 was on approved leave or remote work status during these dates.
narrative: User_06, a DevOps SRE, exhibited highly suspicious behavior by logging in from an unauthorized IP address and performing a massive volume of file reads and downloads over two consecutive days. The pattern of accessing both shared runbooks and departmental files, combined with download volumes far exceeding the user's baseline, strongly indicates a successful data exfiltration incident.
